name: bread
description: BREAD — the umbrella for the stack: batch · grain · mill · proof as submodules, plus the project-wide plans board (PANTRY-hosted).
author: Tjakoen Stolk <tjakoen.s@gmail.com> (https://tjakoen.github.io)

scripts.deps:refresh: for p in batch grain mill proof pantry; do bun add -d @tjakoen/$p@github:tjakoen/$p#$(git ls-remote https://github.com/tjakoen/$p.git main | cut -c1-7); done

//devDependencies: These are the pins of record for the five members; keep the four layer pins matched to pantry's own (deps:refresh re-pins all five). This umbrella is INTENTIONALLY LOCKLESS (bun.lock gitignored): bun (1.3.14 + 1.2.21) cannot resolve this depth-3 nested github git-dep graph — bread -> pantry -> {layers + tjakoen.github.io -> layers} — from scratch; it fails on several specs every run even fully converged to one sha per repo (see the bread-bun-nested-git blocker). bread never needs a lock anyway: everything runs via bunx (cockpit -> bunx pantry, plans:check -> bunx proof), which resolve in isolation and don't use bread's own node_modules. Do NOT try to regenerate a lock here. (standards was folded into the portfolio 2026-07-09 and its repo deleted; pantry resolves /standards from the tjakoen.github.io git-dep.)
